written: after the v3 system was selected on the development set and BEFORE any held-out prediction
not_scored: the unselected base models and rules (development set only)
metrics: sastml.evaluation as v2: per-class P/R/F1, macro-F1 over the classes present, binary vulnerable-vs-safe precision/recall; 95% bootstrap over units (1000 resamples, paired v3 - v2)
decision_rule: v3 replaces v2 only if, on both held-out sets together, (1) v3's macro-F1 is higher than v2's AND (2) v3's binary precision is not lower than v2's AND (3) the paired bootstrap 95% CI of v3 - v2 macro-F1 lies above 0. Anything else (tie or unclear) keeps v2 deployed and v3 packaged only. Even if all three hold, deployment waits for the user's approval.
scored_once: scripts/v3/eval_heldout_v3.py refuses to run twice; no tuning afterwards
